text:
Alice K: Quick check — embeddings endpoint launch: batching limits, vector dims, model selection, response format. Need a short go/no-go checklist for Thurs demo. What are the current blockers?
Diego R: Ops + perf: we need upper bound on batch size before latency SLOs break. Running load tests now, but early numbers show tail latency at batch 512 on A100 starts spiking.
Sam L: Model side: two candidate models — open-3-xl (1536d) and open-2-large (1024d). open-3 gives better recall but ~1.6x cost. For first-gen we considered 1024d as default.
Priya N: From CS: two pilot customers asked for >1536 dims and single-request multi-input. They care about inference cost and compatibility with their vector stores.
Maya O: Infra note: GPU memory quantization profile impacts max batch. With FP16+4-bit quant we can hit batch 1024 at 1k tokens but KV cache makes it tricky.
Sam L: Proposal: default API returns 1024 dims, offer `?model=...` to pick 1536/2048 variants. Need API schema that includes `dimension` field so downstream can validate.
Alice K: Agree on default 1024. Action items: (1) finalize model list, (2) define batch limits & error behavior, (3) finalize response format. Owners?
Diego R: I'll own batch limits + error codes. Suggest we return 429 when request size > max_batch and 413 for payload > max_payload_bytes.
Sam L: I'll own model catalog + dimension field. Suggest response includes `model` and `dimension` in metadata.
Priya N: CS asks for a migration note — if we change default dims later, customers should get explicit notice and a compatibility header.
Alice K: For response shape, minimal but explicit. Example we discussed:
```
{
  "data": [ {"id": "0", "embedding": [0.0012, -0.23, ... ] } ],
  "model": "open-2-large",
  "dimension": "1024",
  "usage": {"input_bytes": 1234}
}
```
Diego R: small change: `dimension` should be integer, `id` string, and include `batch_size` top-level for analytics.
Sam L: Also add `vector_format` enum: `raw_f32`, `f16_packed`, `base64` — defaults to `raw_f32` for hosted API; dedicated/private can enable `f16_packed`.
Maya O: Ops concern: streaming vs non-streaming for bulk embeddings. For now block streaming for multi-input to keep server memory predictable.
Priya N: Legal asked about PII in embeddings. Add note to docs: embeddings are not stored by default, opt-in for retention.
Alice K: Launch criteria suggestion: 1) perf: median latency < 70ms for batch 64 on hosted; 2) error modes handled with clear codes; 3) docs + migration note; 4) two pilot customers sign-off.
Diego R: Timeline: load test finish today, PR for batch logic by EOD tomorrow, rollout to staging Wed, canary Thur morning.
Sam L: Model weights licensing: confirm open-3-xl license is compatible with hosted; if not, we drop it from hosted and keep only in dedicated.
Priya N: Customer comms: I'll draft a short note describing dims, default choices, and how to opt into higher-dim models.
Alice K: Ok owners — I'll compile checklist and ship a one-pager. Ping here with any blockers. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: note: staging deploy scheduled: service/embeddings v0.9 -> staging at 2026-03-18T22:00:00Z
Diego R: Load test finished — tail at 512 still spiky, switching quant profile reduced tail but increased bias slightly. Need Sam to confirm quality trade-off.
Sam L: Will run evals on quant profiles overnight and post results in #eng-ml tomorrow.
Priya N: CS: please include customer impact matrix in that one-pager — which customers need which dims.
Alice K: Thanks everyone, will loop back with the one-pager by EOD. Reminder: keep API backwards compatible where possible. :wave:
